Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SoundRadiusRed: How far a suppressed shot carries compared with a normal shot. Lower is quieter. Default: 20%% of normal range. At 100, range is unchanged. Oil-filter suppressors carry farther than machined ones.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SoundVolumeRed: Scales the suppressed shot's volume setting. Lower values reduce it; 100 leaves the weapon's original value unchanged. Default: 55. The recording also affects loudness, so 50 does not mean half as loud.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SuppressorDura: Shots from full condition to worn out. Applies to both suppressor types. At 0 condition, suppression stops. Machined suppressors can be repaired; oil-filter suppressors must be replaced.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_EnableSuppress: Adds welding recipes to restore worn machined suppressors to full condition. Requires tools and materials. Oil-filter suppressors cannot be repaired.

Sustained fire heats the suppressor until its surface glows. Smoke rises while aiming; both fade as it cools. Heat does not affect accuracy, damage, or sound reduction. Whether a hot suppressor also wears faster is a separate setting (on by default).
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_ContentScope_t: Choose the families this save can use and find. Existing servers retain any older per-caliber settings until they are changed manually.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilFilterCraft: Metalworking level needed to craft any oil-filter suppressor. Default: 3. Adapter requirements are set separately; the manual is still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_AdapterCraftLe: Metalworking level needed to craft caliber adapters. Default: 2. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined12Gaug: Metalworking level needed to craft the 12 Gauge machined suppressor. Default: 8. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined556Cra: Metalworking level needed to craft the 5.56 machined suppressor. Default: 7. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined9mmCra: Metalworking level needed to craft the 9mm machined suppressor. Default: 5. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined45ACPC: Metalworking level needed to craft the .45 ACP machined suppressor. Default: 5. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined308Cra: Metalworking level needed to craft the .308 machined suppressor. Default: 7. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined357Cra: Metalworking level needed to craft the .357 machined suppressor. Default: 6. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined44Craf: Metalworking level needed to craft the .44 machined suppressor. Default: 5. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Machined3030Cr: Metalworking level needed to craft the .30-30 machined suppressor. Default: 6. The manual and recipe materials are still required.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilFilterWearM: How often a running engine loses condition below 25%% oil. Once the sump runs completely dry, damage is tripled. A missing filter leaks oil but does not damage the engine until it becomes low. Default: every 1 in-game minute.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilFilterEngin: VEHICLES | Engine condition lost per interval
Condition lost each low-oil interval. Once the sump runs completely dry, this amount is tripled -- a dry engine seizes within minutes of driving. Default: 4.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_LootRarity_too: How common this mod's loot is. 100 uses the standard loot weights; lower is rarer, higher is more common. Applies to crafting supplies and manuals even in craft-only mode. 0 removes all mod loot, including manuals. Does not change containers already filled.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_FindSuppressor: Adds finished suppressors to loot. Turn off for craft-only suppressors: manuals, adapters, baffles, and oil filters can still be found. Vehicle filter salvage remains available. Does not remove items already spawned.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable12GaugeS: Allows 12 Gauge suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot. Double-barrel shotguns and the sawn-off JS-2000 are excluded.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable556Suppr: Allows 5.56 suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable9mmSuppr: Allows 9mm suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable45ACPSup: Allows .45 ACP suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable308Suppr: Allows .308 suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable3030Supp: Allows .30-30 suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable357Suppr: Allows .357 suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Enable44Suppre: Allows .44 suppressors to attach and work on supported guns, and includes matching suppressors and adapters in loot. The Desert Eagle is supported; the Magnum revolver is excluded.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_DevStartingKit: DEVELOPER | Give new characters a test kit
Starts new characters with guns, ammunition, suppressors, and crafting tools. For testing; leave off for a normal playthrough.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilFilterRemov: Time spent removing a vehicle oil filter at the engine. Default: 10 seconds. The removed filter can be used for crafting or installed in a vehicle.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_Debug_tooltip: Writes extra diagnostic information to the game log. Useful when reporting a problem; leave off during normal play.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_EnableVehicleO: Tracks oil level. Removing a filter creates a visible puddle, then leaks -- slowly while parked, but a full sump empties in minutes of driving under oil-pump pressure. Fitting a filter stops the leak but does not refill the engine. Filtered oil does not expire; damage begins only when running below 25%% oil, and a completely dry engine will seize and need mechanical repair.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_VehicleOilSeve: Controls how quickly a dangerously low-oil engine loses condition. It does not make oil expire or cause instant engine damage.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilChangeHours: Kept only so existing server configurations remain valid. Engine oil no longer expires with time; drain and refill only to recover from a leak.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_MachinedSoundR: How far a machined-suppressor shot carries compared with the unsuppressed firearm. Default: 25%%.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_OilFilterSound: How far an oil-filter-suppressor shot carries compared with the unsuppressed firearm. Default: 35%%.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_HeatAccelerate: Hot suppressors lose condition faster. At maximum heat, each shot uses twice the normal lifespan. Default: enabled.
